name: Shibun · Gremlet #21
description:
A shiba pup with a curly tail and a smile that never quite turns off.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Shibun in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
